text: There's a town in America with a population of one.
Monowi, Nebraska once had over a hundred people. Then the shops closed. The schools merged. People left.
By the year two thousand, only two were left: Elsie and her husband, Rudy.
In two thousand four, Rudy died.
So Elsie became the mayor. And the clerk. And the treasurer. And the librarian. And the bartender.
Every year, she issues herself a liquor licence... and signs it.
Every election, she votes for herself.
Rudy loved books. His last wish was a public library. So Elsie opened one: five thousand books, open to anyone.
And she kept the tavern open.
People drive up to eighty miles just to sit at her bar.
Not everyone has a tavern full of friends down the road.
That's why we made Feeloy. Jenny is always there, remembers your story, and keeps the door open, day and night.
